annotation.title_clean: Plan de Acción de la Estrategia Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial Costa Rica 2024–2027 (Versión agosto 2025)
annotation.title_en: Action Plan of the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy of Costa Rica 2024–2027 (August 2025 version)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio de Ciencia, Innovación, Tecnología y Telecomunicaciones (MICITT), Costa Rica
annotation.summary_en: August 2025 public version of the action plan for Costa Rica's National AI Strategy 2024–2027, issued by MICITT. It sets axes, actions, indicators, targets and responsible institutions covering ethical AI, territorial and economic development, R&D, smart government and international leadership. It contains no robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Axis 1 aims to develop ethical and regulatory frameworks for AI use and access
Axis 2 provides technical assistance and training for SMEs and local governments to adopt AI
Axis 3 sets an R&D agenda and funds applied AI research calls
Axis 4 deploys AI in public institutions with a digital catalogue of public-sector AI projects
Axis 7 promotes international AI governance cooperation and trade-agreement provisions on ethical AI
